attributes.action: To implement drug testing for sitting members of parliament
attributes.additional_details:
MPs have so much control over our lives. They set laws, they set taxes and policies that impact our businesses and the economy as a whole. They decide on military action and take votes on matters of national security.
Any one taking drugs cannot think straight or make trusted judgements.
attributes.background: To implement drug testing for members of parliament, in line with that of the police.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject, which you may wish to sign:

Mandate alcohol breathalyser and drug swab tests in House of Commons
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768899
